records.title: Serena Williams Returns to Pro Tennis After Four-Year Hiatus
records.summary: PARIS (AP) — Serena Williams is coming back to professional tennis at the age of 44, returning to the sport she dominated for two decades before famously “evolving” away from the daily grind of competition.

records.title: McDonald’s Bets on Fancier Chicken, Airier Restaurants to Keep Luring Diners
records.summary: McDonald’s Corp. is betting on everything from fancier chicken to new playgrounds as part of a campaign to make fast food feel less like fast food.

records.title: Australian LNG Workers to Start Strikes at Inpex’s Ichthys Plant
records.summary: Workers at Inpex Corp.’s Ichthys liquefied natural gas export project in Australia will start strikes after talks between union members and the company stalled.

records.title: Tracking Down Ebola Survivors in Remote Mountains to Find a Cure
records.summary: One scientist studies blood samples, sees lasting effect almost 20 years after infection

records.title: Anthropic’s First-Mover IPO Edge Set to Widen Lead Over OpenAI
records.summary: Anthropic PBC pulled ahead of OpenAI with its confidential IPO filing Monday, as the free-spending artificial intelligence startups battle for a fundraising edge that’s set to determine who will win the ultimate battle for computing power.

records.title: New Zealand Banks Agree Merger to Challenge Larger Rivals
records.summary: Two of New Zealand’s second-tier lenders, Heartland Bank and TSB Bank have agreed to merge to create a new entity better able to challenge the Australian banks that dominate the local market.

records.title: Royalton Ceases Work in Cuba as Sanctions Loom Over Hotel Sector
records.summary: The Cuban subsidiary of Royalton Hotels & Resorts Ltd. shut down its operations on the island after the US imposed a de facto fuel blockade on the communist government and expanded sanctions to target foreign companies.

records.title: Abivax Says Ulcerative Colitis Drug Met Goal in Late-Stage Trial
records.summary: Abivax SA said its experimental drug helped patients with a chronic inflammatory bowel disease in a crucial study that could prompt takeover offers for the French biotech.

records.title: Princeton Endowment Backs Out of Oil and Gas Divestment Pledge
records.summary: Princeton University’s endowment is backtracking on its pledge to divest from publicly traded oil and gas companies, four years after it said it would exit such holdings as way to move toward a net-zero portfolio.

records.title: Vegas Tourism Hit, Online Rivals Put Caesars and MGM in Play
records.summary: Whammied by the twin trends of declining visitors to Las Vegas and the growth of prediction market betting, two of the most storied names in the casino business now find themselves the subject of takeovers.

records.title: Covid Pandemic Left 55,000 Cancer Cases Undiagnosed Across 7 Nations, Study Finds
records.summary: About 55,000 cancer cases went undiagnosed across seven high-income countries during the first nine months of the Covid-19 pandemic, underscoring the extent to which lockdowns and health-system disruptions affected routine medical care, a study found.

records.title: Oil Climbs as Traders Weigh Fresh Threat to Middle East Supply
records.summary: Oil rose by the most since early May as traders priced in signals that energy flows out of the Middle East could be curtailed further.

records.title: Drahi’s Optimum Strikes Equity Deal to Bring Creditors It Sued to Table
records.summary: Optimum Communications reached a deal to raise capital at a unit that moves assets out of the reach of lenders that were sued by the company, in a move the troubled telco operator said will boost the chances of reaching a debt-overhaul agreement with the creditor group.

records.title: US Spot Petrochemical Prices Ease as Export Demand Starts to Lag
records.summary: US spot petrochemical prices softened across the board last week as export demand for the plastics building blocks appears to weaken for the month of June.

records.title: Barry Diller Offers to Buy Rest of MGM in Deal Valued at Nearly $19 Billion
records.summary: Barry Diller has made an offer for the remaining portion of MGM Resorts International he doesn’t already own, marking the latest pivot for the billionaire media mogul after overhauling IAC Inc.

records.title: Drug Firm Apotex Seeks Valuation Over C$5 Billion in Canada IPO
records.summary: Canadian drug manufacturer Apotex Health Corp. and its shareholders are looking to raise as much as C$1.15 billion (about $830 million) in an initial public offering, at a valuation that would mean a healthy profit for SK Capital Partners.

records.title: US Construction Spending on Data Centers Eclipses $50 Billion
records.summary: Spending on data-center construction in the US eclipsed $50 billion in April for the first time, according to Census Bureau figures published Monday.

records.title: Indian Agency Arrests Former Top Executive of Anil Ambani’s Firm
records.summary: India’s federal investigative agency on Monday arrested a former senior executive of Anil Ambani-backed Reliance Communications Ltd. over alleged misuse of loans, as it stepped up scrutiny of the one-time billionaire’s businesses.

records.title: London Commuters Brace for Travel Disruption From Tube Strikes
records.summary: Londoners are set for significant travel disruption this week starting on Tuesday, as some drivers on the city’s Underground train network prepare to strike in a dispute over working hours.

records.title: Summit Falls as Chinese Data on Cancer Drug Fails to Impress
records.summary: Summit Therapeutics Inc. declined Monday after doctors questioned whether positive survival data from a Chinese trial of the company’s lung cancer drug ivonescimab would translate to the generally older US population.

records.title: Walmart Caps Usage of an AI Tool for Employees After High Demand
records.summary: Walmart Inc. is limiting staff’s usage of an artificial-intelligence tool following high demand, illustrating how corporations are adjusting their calculations for incorporating the technology.

records.title: BP Executive Lin to Leave as New CEO Prepares Overhaul
records.summary: BP Plc executive William Lin is to leave the energy major as the company undertakes an overhaul of its structure and its senior leadership.

records.title: GM Supplier Strike Threatens Pickup Plant Shutdown Within Weeks
records.summary: General Motors Co. could be forced to halt output at a Michigan truck plant later this month after union workers at axle supplier Dauch Corp. walked off the job in a labor dispute.

records.title: South Africa Factory Sentiment Worsens as Demand Fades
records.summary: South Africa’s manufacturer sentiment worsened in May as demand slumped and supply disruptions due to the Iran war continued.

records.title: AI Is Forcing Big Law to Rethink Business as Usual
records.summary: In 2021, Volkswagen AG approached the global law firm Freshfields with a problem. records.title: Netherlands Backs $1.2 Billion Subsidy to Refill Gas Stocks
records.summary: The Netherlands has approved a subsidy of as much as €993 million ($1.2 billion) for state-owned energy company EBN Capital BV to bolster the country’s depleted gas reserves.

records.title: SpaceX Reserves Up to 5% of IPO Stock for Staff and Friends
records.summary: SpaceX will reserve up to 5% of shares in its upcoming initial public offering for certain employees and friends and family of its executive officers, the company disclosed in an amended filing.

records.title: Honeywell-Backed Quantinuum Boosts IPO Target to $1.46 Billion
records.summary: Honeywell International Inc.-backed quantum computing company Quantinuum Inc. boosted the size of its initial public offering to as much as $1.46 billion, raising the number of shares offered and the price range.

records.title: India’s Zee Clinches Rights to Broadcast FIFA Football World Cup
records.summary: India’s Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd. won the rights to broadcast the FIFA World Cup 2026 in the country, ending suspense over the telecast of the sporting event in one of the world’s largest media markets.

records.title: Hiab Agrees to Acquire Truck Maker Labrie for $1.04 Billion
records.summary: Finnish-listed Hiab Oyj has agreed to acquire refuse collection vehicle manufacturer Labrie Environmental Group at an enterprise value of $1.04 billion, as it aims to strengthen its foothold in the North American waste and recycling market.
